title: Who Is Jiji Thomson, The Congressi Ex-Kerala Chief Secretary Targeting CEC, Who ‘Spread The Gospel’ And Was Allegedly Honey-Trapped?
summary: The opposition parties and sections of the media step up their attacks on Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). Now, former Kerala Chief Secretary Jiji Thomson has entered the fray with a claim about Kumar’s alleged political links, as reported in OpIndia.
